name: wplus-ui-wordpress-theme
description: Build step for the WPlus UI WordPress theme: minified CSS/JS used when SCRIPT_DEBUG is off.

scripts.build: cat assets/css/style.css assets/css/wp-extras.css | esbuild --loader=css --minify > assets/css/style.min.css && esbuild assets/js/script.js --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=assets/js/script.min.js
